steps.task: 冻结原创风格、四套皮肤、地图/基地交付与审批合同
使用最高质量图像模型生成 source-only 概念稿并保存 provenance
补齐稳定 ID/版本/SHA/provenance、机器技术/视觉/相似风险审查、runtime 派生、fallback、feature flag 与回滚，形成 OWNER_AUTHORIZED_ART_CLEARANCE
取得所有者清除后独立建立可逆 default-on runtime/Manifest/回退 QA；发布仍须当前用户明确命令

risks: 生成图出现 AI 痕迹或商业 IP 相似性
材质细节遮挡游戏可读性
未获 OWNER_AUTHORIZED_ART_CLEARANCE 的资源误进入 manifest
透明边缘/暗黑主题/多尺寸派生质量不足
tests: 机器小尺寸/相似风险/回滚验证；可选人工咨询单独记录
optionalAdvisoryPolicy: All listed items are OPTIONAL_ADVISORY_EVIDENCE / NOT_EXECUTED and non-blocking; never fabricate PASS.
externalAssetPolicy: blocked-license / EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_ONLY assets are permanently forbidden from source derivation, generation input, runtime and release

historicalAsOf.meaning: The former candidate-only/default-off plan treated human cleanup, Reviewer B, IP Review and Golden Set as runtime prerequisites; retained for audit only.

rollback: 当前源稿不进入运行时；取得 clearance 后也必须能以 feature flag 回到现有 Tank 表现，不改 Authority、规则、协议、奖励或用户数据。
